name: app-shater-giant-wordmark-desktop-dashboard-with-store-badges
title: Shater giant wordmark behind a desktop dashboard, phone and craftsman photo with App Store badges
whatItIs: A navy cover with a huge diagonally-lit 'Shater' wordmark filling the top, a desktop admin dashboard on a monitor stand, two phone screens, a smiling craftsman in a hi-vis vest, and App Store / Google Play badges in the corner.
whatItMeans: Confident and complete; showing desktop, mobile and store badges together signals a finished, launched product.
techniques: Fill the top of a cover with a giant lit wordmark.
Combine desktop and mobile in one hero shot.
Add store badges as proof of a real launch.

vocabulary.definition: An official App Store or Google Play download button.
Light falling across type at an angle for drama.
